_provenance: ICPAC onset-date scheme, sampled from the GHACOF OND 2026 onset map: one colour per dekad from the start of the search window (R colours greenyellow, lawngreen, palegreen, darkseagreen, forestgreen, darkgreen, darkolivegreen, olivedrab, orange, slateblue; then mediumturquoise for the open-ended last swatch), which on ICPAC's OND map read Sep 1, 11, 21, Oct 1, 11, 21, 31, Nov 10, 20, 30 and 'Dec 10 or later'; the grey at the foot of ICPAC's legend is here the open lower end (before the window start; ICPAC also uses it for dry / no-onset cells, which a TercileStyle dry_mask supplies). Levels are days since the window start, so the same scale anchors to any season: label the colorbar ticks with dates.
label: Onset date (days since window start)
